title: DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Dev Ops Engineer (Azure & CI/CD) – 5+ Years Experience (Hybrid, Delhi NCR) Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Dev Ops Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on Dev Ops experience to drive our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD initiatives. In this individual contributor role (with team mentoring responsibilities), you will integrate software development and IT operations to accelerate delivery and enhance system reliability. By automating processes, managing infrastructure as code, and fostering collaboration, you’ll ensure that continuous integration and deployment pipelines run efficiently and securely in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment. You will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between development and operations, spearhead the design of CI/CD pipelines, and oversee monitoring and incident response for mission-critical systems. Key Responsibilities CI/CD Pipeline Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (using Git Lab CI/CD and Git Hub Actions) to automate build, test, and deployment processes for software releases. Ensure rapid and reliable deployments with proper version control and rollback strategies. System Reliability & Monitoring: Establish end-to-end monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks to continuously track system performance and uptime. Take accountability for monitoring metrics. Proactively troubleshoot issues, lead incident response efforts, and implement improvements to achieve high availability and resiliency in production environments. Infrastructure as Code & Cloud Management: Manage and provision cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure using Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g. Terraform, ARM templates) for consistent and scalable environments. Maintain cloud resources (VMs, containers, networks, databases) and optimize for performance, cost, and security. Automation & Tooling: Develop scripts and automation tools to streamline configuration management, environment setup, and other operational tasks. Eliminate manual processes by leveraging scripting (Shell, Power Shell, Python) and configuration management tools, thereby improving team efficiency. Security & Compliance: Integrate security best practices into the CI/CD and cloud management process. Manage secrets and access control, ensure compliance with industry standards and internal policies, and collaborate with security teams to conduct regular audits and vulnerability assessments on infrastructure and pipelines. Collaboration & Dev Ops Best Practices: Work closely with software developers, QA engineers, and IT operations to promote a Dev Ops culture of shared responsibility and rapid feedback. Improve development workflows by advocating for agile practices, continuous improvement, and use of tools that bridge development and operations (e.g. Git workflows, issue tracking, chatops). Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor junior Dev Ops engineers and team members by sharing knowledge and best practices. Provide guidance through code reviews of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure code, conduct training sessions on Dev Ops tools/methodologies, and foster an environment of learning and innovation. Requirements Required Skills & Experience Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in a Dev Ops and Site Reliability Engineering role, with a strong track record of managing production-grade CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. Dev Ops & CI/CD Tools: Expertise in source control and CI/CD platforms, especially Git Lab and Git Hub (including Git Lab CI pipelines and Git Hub Actions). Hands-on experience with additional CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or Azure Dev Ops is highly valuable. Azure Cloud Mastery: In-depth practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services and resources. Ability to design and operate solutions using Azure infrastructure (compute, storage, networking) and related services, ensuring performance and security at scale. Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Strong experience writing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code templates/scripts (e.g. Terraform, Azure Resource Manager templates) to automate environment provisioning and configuration management. Containers & Orchestration: Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies – particularly Docker and Kubernetes – to deploy and manage applications in scalable containerized environments. Scripting & Automation: Solid programming/scripting skills in at least one language (e.g. Bash, Power Shell, Python) for automating CI/CD tasks, tool integrations, and routine operations. Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools (such as Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Elastic Stack and Datadog) to track system health and quickly diagnose issues. Networking & Security Fundamentals: Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, firewalls) and cloud security practices (identity and access management, secret management, vulnerability scanning) to ensure robust and secure infrastructure.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Relevant industry certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Dev Ops Engineer Expert is a plus. Preferred / Additional Qualifications Multi-Cloud Exposure: Familiarity with other cloud platforms like Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a strong plus, indicating ability to apply Dev Ops best practices in a multi-cloud environment. Additional Dev Ops Tools: Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet, and with container orchestration tools or cloud CI/CD services, will be advantageous. Certifications: Professional certifications that demonstrate Dev Ops and cloud expertise are preferred. Examples include AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer, Professional Cloud Dev Ops Engineer Certification or related credentials. Soft Skills & Competencies Communication & Collaboration: Fluent communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. A strong team player who collaborates effectively across development, operations, and QA teams. Resilience Under Pressure: Proven ability to work calmly and efficiently under pressure, especially during critical production incidents or tight deadlines. Demonstrates strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment when troubleshooting high-stakes issues in live environments. Leadership & Mentoring: A proactive leader who takes ownership of initiatives and helps uplift the team. Capable of mentoring junior engineers, providing constructive feedback, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. Impact: This role offers the opportunity to shape and enhance the Dev Ops landscape of the organization. You will directly contribute to faster delivery cycles, more reliable releases, and a strengthened engineering team through your technical expertise and leadership in best practices. If you are passionate about automation, cloud reliability, and mentoring others in Dev Ops excellence, we encourage you to apply and help drive our infrastructure and delivery to the next level. Location & Work Model: Delhi NCR, India – Hybrid (combination of remote and on-site work).

title: TechOps Data Analytics- Aviation
jobDescription:
We are inviting applications from motivated, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy professionals for the position of Tech Ops Data Analytics in the Aviation Technical Records and flydocs domain. This role bridges technical records management and data analytics, focusing on transforming aircraft maintenance and operational data into actionable insights that support technical, commercial, and compliance decisions. Travel: Travel may be required as per business needs Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Extract, clean, and structure data from flydocs and other aircraft record systems. • Develop analytics models and dashboards to track aircraft asset status, maintenance history, and document completeness. • Automate data validation, report generation, and recurring analyses using tools like Power BI, Python, and SQL. • Collaborate with internal teams (Technical Records, CAMO, Planning, and IT) to identify process improvement and automation opportunities. • Perform statistical and trend analyses (e.g., reliability trends, shop visit intervals, component performance). • Support the development of standardized data models for fleet-level and aircraft-level analytics. • Contribute to documentation analytics projects (data mapping, completeness, and compliance insights). Requirements • 2–3 years of experience in Aircraft Technical Records / Technical Services / Data Analytics. • Strong understanding of aircraft documentation (AMP, AD/SB, task cards, FSR, CS, etc.). • Proficiency or working knowledge of Power BI, Excel (Advanced), SQL, Python, or other analytics tools. • Analytical mindset with attention to data structure, accuracy, and visualization. • Strong problem-solving, data interpretation, and documentation skills. • Willingness to learn new digital tools, APIs, and automation workflows. • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Desirable (Good to Have): • Experience working on flydocs / AMOS / Trax / other records management platforms. • Exposure to Power Automate or VBA automation. • Understanding of aircraft asset management or maintenance forecasting. Benefits • Hands-on experience in transforming raw aviation data into decision-making dashboards. • Exposure to digital transformation projects within aviation MRO and records management. • Continuous learning opportunities in data visualization, business intelligence, and automation. • Collaboration with cross-functional aviation and analytics experts.

title: Taxation Executive (Contractual)
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Taxation Executive (Contractual) Engagement Type: Contractor / Consultant Experience Required: Minimum 3–4 years Location: Hybrid/Vadodara Role Overview The Taxation Consultant will be engaged on a contractual basis to provide end-to-end taxation consulting, compliance support, and advisory services to the company. The role requires strong hands-on experience in Indian taxation laws, including GST, TDS, Income Tax, and related statutory compliances, with practical exposure gained from a reputed consulting or professional services firm. Key Responsibilities
1. Goods and Services Tax (GST) End-to-end GST compliance including: Preparation, review, and filing of GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, GSTR-9/9C). Monthly/quarterly GST reconciliations between books, returns, and portal data. Advisory support on GST applicability, classification, valuation, place of supply, and rate issues. Handling GST notices, departmental queries, audits, and assessments. Support in GST registrations, amendments, refunds, LUT filings, and input tax credit optimisation. Advising on GST implications for contracts, inter-company transactions, and new business initiatives.
2. Direct Taxation (Income Tax & TDS) Compliance and advisory under the Income-tax Act,
1961. Review and filing of TDS/TCS returns (Forms 24Q, 26Q, 27Q, etc.). Advisory on TDS applicability, rates, withholding mechanisms, and exemptions. Handling TDS reconciliations, Form 26Q/24Q corrections, and Form 16/16A issuance. Support in income tax computations, advance tax workings, and return filings (as applicable). Assistance in handling income tax notices, assessments, and correspondence with tax authorities.
3. Tax Advisory & Support Advising management on tax-efficient structures and transactions. Supporting tax positions for audits (statutory, internal, tax audits). Reviewing agreements, invoices, and transactions from a tax risk perspective. Monitoring changes in tax laws, circulars, notifications, and judicial precedents and assessing their impact on the company.
4. Compliance & Documentation Ensuring timely compliance with all statutory tax requirements. Maintaining proper tax documentation, workings, and audit trails. Coordinating with internal finance teams, auditors, and external consultants as required. Engagement Expectations Contractor to work closely with the company’s finance and accounts team. Engagement may be part-time / full-time / project-based depending on business requirements. Expected to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of taxation-related deliverables. Requirements Key Requirements Experience: Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in Indian taxation. Prior experience with a reputed CA firm / consulting firm / professional services firm is mandatory. Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of GST laws, rules, and return filing. Good understanding of TDS provisions and Income Tax compliance. Skills: Practical, solution-oriented approach to taxation issues. Ability to work independently in a consulting/contractual setup. Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills. Qualification: CA Inter / CA drop out/ MBA (Finance) / Qualified tax professional (preferred but not mandatory based on experience).

title: Engineer - TechOps Automation
jobDescription: We are seeking a Tech Ops Automation Engineer (Document Processing & Compliance Automation) with strong Python expertise to build intelligent automation solutions for document verification, compliance processing, workflow automation, and AI-powered data extraction. The role involves developing automation for PDF/Excel processing, integrating Open AI/Azure Open AI models, building Python-based GUI tools, and implementing cloud storage automation using Azure or GCP. The engineer will collaborate with Tech Ops and Compliance teams to replace manual verification processes with scalable, automated systems that improve accuracy, speed, and reporting quality. Requirements Core Technical Skills Strong Python 3.x development experience (OOP, modular coding, async/multithreading, exception handling, logging). PDF & document processing using Py Mu PDF (fitz), pdfplumber, Py PDF2, and OCR tools such as Tesseract, Easy OCR, Paddle OCR. Excel/Spreadsheet automation using openpyxl, pandas, and regex for pattern extraction. GUI-based tool development using Py Qt6/Py Side6 with threaded execution, progress bars, file selectors, and log views. Experience integrating Open AI GPT / Azure Open AI for extraction, summarization, classification, and anomaly detection. Cloud automation experience with Azure (preferred) or GCP including: Blob/Cloud Storage, Functions/Cloud Functions, App Service/Cloud Run SAS/OAuth authentication Key Vault / IAM for secret management REST API development and integrations using Fast API/Flask, JSON/XML processing, and webhooks. Version control and best practices using Git, code reviews, documentation, and CI/CD basics. Experience with Postgre SQL or Mongo DB for data persistence. Functional Responsibilities Develop automated workflows for document handling, verification, extraction, and compliance reporting. Build AI-driven pipelines combining Python rules and GPT logic for decision-making and anomaly detection. Automate comparison of fields such as PN/SN/POS and generate structured validation reports. Integrate automation with Azure/GCP storage and internal REST APIs. Deliver well-structured Python modules with scalability, logging, performance optimization, and error handling. Convert manual processes into reliable automation for operations and compliance teams. Experience Level 2 to 4 years of experience in Python Automation / Document Processing / AI-driven automation. Good-to-Have Skills Ui Path, Power Automate, or RPA experience Node.js scripting Excel VBA automations Serverless microservices exposure Share Point/One Drive automation experience Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving ability Attention to detail (critical for compliance workflows) Good communication and documentation abilities Ability to work independently, own deliverables, and collaborate with cross-functional teams Benefits Professional Growth Opportunity to work with advanced AI/Open AI automation and cloud technologies. Involvement in building end-to-end automation products, not just scripts. Continuous learning support: courses, tech sessions, and certifications. Work Environment Flexible Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (Vadodara Office) working options. Ownership-driven role with freedom to design automation workflows. Collaboration with Tech Ops, Compliance, and Product Engineering teams. Rewards & Compensation Competitive contract-based compensation Performance-based rewards or project milestone bonuses (if applicable) Tools & Infrastructure Access to advanced automation stack: Open AI/Azure Open AI credits, OCR APIs, Azure/GCP services. High-performance development environment, cloud environments, and dev resources. Career Advancement Growth opportunities toward: Automation Lead / Tech Ops Lead AI Automation Specialist Solution Architect – Intelligent Automation
